repo.purpose: Compact machine-readable progress and lessons record for the user's own long-running Codex experiment to earn verified net revenue of 100 RMB or equivalent USD.
not_this: not an external multi-agent relay project
not a place where humans review or approve ordinary agent strategy

goal_status.goal: Earn verified net revenue >= 100 RMB or equivalent USD.
goal_status.completion_rule: Only verified net revenue >= 100 RMB or equivalent USD with evidence_path or explicit user confirmation completes the goal.
goal_status.zero_break_rule: Breaking zero requires confirmed net revenue > 0.

latest_updates.summary: Low-memory platform check completed across Xianyu, X/Twitter, Tieba, ZBJ, and EPWK. No real inquiry, order, payment, or revenue appeared.
Read-only active acquisition screen found PeoplePerHour PowerPoint/template jobs as the best visible new demand. No proposal, bid, login, message, or revenue occurred.
Prepared a truthful 4-slide editable demo deck for a possible PeoplePerHour proposal. It is an outreach asset only, not revenue evidence.
Corrected the daily automation positioning: progress files are human spectator pages, not review or approval files.
Opened the first lightweight read-only skill as SKILL.md for progress watching, lesson reuse, and support boundaries.
Renamed the public project to Agent Employment Guide / agent就业指南 and published the GitHub repository at caiyongkun-coder/agent-employment-guide.

Aligned local continuation notes and automations with the Agent Employment Guide path, approved read-only SKILL.md, and the rule that tips, donations, and support payments do not count as experiment revenue.

Formalized the repository for public use with Apache-2.0 licensing, bilingual README files, generic AgentSkills-compatible instructions, public Alipay/WeChat Pay support QR assets, and support privacy boundaries.

Narrowed the daily automation policy so it may update only the two human progress pages and agent_context.json; README, skill, support, license, QR assets, and other repository structure files must be left unchanged unless the user explicitly requests a design update.

Ran a compatibility review for Hermes/OpenClaw-style loading and clarified SKILL.md path resolution so the tap-style copy points agents back to the repository root for agent_context.json, progress files, and support files.
Read-only V2EX public API/RSS screen found no fresh small office/PPT buyer; a visible algorithm bounty was complex and not a fast 100 RMB office sprint. No write action or revenue occurred.
Updated the public progress board to include a compressed timeline starting from the real project start date, 2026-06-05, and documented the memory-compaction rule for future daily summaries.

Strengthened the skill freshness protocol: agents answering latest-progress questions must refresh the git clone or fetch GitHub raw progress/context files before answering, and must disclose when only a cached local copy is available.

progress_memory_policy.style: compressed timeline similar to context compaction
rules: early history should be summarized by date and lesson, not copied as heartbeat logs
recent days should keep more operational detail
the newest meaningful checks should be the most specific
repeated no-signal heartbeats should be collapsed unless they change the plan
verified revenue, broke-zero status, orders, inquiries, evidence rules, and hard safety boundaries must never be compressed away

timeline_by_date.summary: Experiment started. Packaged existing bank data warehouse / SQL interview-story material into a 109 RMB Xianyu service offer, published the first listing, prepared/sent X/Twitter CTA material, and created revenue verification rules. Views appeared but no inquiry, order, or verified revenue. Late-day work added or prepared resume rewrite and night-rush urgent office-help directions.
timeline_by_date.lesson: A live listing and early views are not revenue; evidence rules are needed before counting anything.

timeline_by_date.summary: Expanded from one Xianyu listing into multiple urgent-office offers, improved night-rush visuals, added a morning/same-day urgent offer, and tightened X/Twitter outreach and conversion material. No-inquiry thresholds triggered strategy-review and pivot rules.
timeline_by_date.lesson: When exposure does not become buyer conversation, stop spending most effort on listing-surface tweaks.

timeline_by_date.summary: Broadened into active acquisition and task marketplaces. The 19 RMB diagnostic Xianyu funnel appeared deleted/unavailable and cannot complete the goal alone. GitHub/Boss/Algora/Opire screens found no clean fixed-cash low-competition task. Tieba and public buyer-intent searches were low-yield or unstable. ZBJ service was published and public detail verified, but no buyer/order appeared. EPWK showed real demand but was blocked by paid bid chances, membership/skill tags, CAPTCHA, account timing, or detail gates.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Marketplace demand can be real but unusable when the free participation path is blocked.

timeline_by_date.summary: Old surfaces kept producing exposure but no conversion. PeoplePerHour became the best visible fresh buyer-demand path, with local proposal previews and a truthful sample deck prepared but no proposal submitted. X buyer signal @N1C0323 remained the best X write candidate. V2EX showed no fast small office/PPT buyer. Agent Employment Guide was formalized as a public bilingual progress/lessons repository with generic skill support and support-payment boundaries.
timeline_by_date.lesson: The next meaningful move needs explicit user confirmation for a write/account action, or a genuinely fresh read-only free-path discovery.

skill_policy.first_version_style: single Markdown skill with a tap-compatible copy; no helper scripts
skill_policy.compatibility_goal: Support any agent runtime that can read repository instructions or SKILL.md files, not only Codex.
compatible_runtimes_examples: other agents that can read Markdown instructions
modes: watch progress in Chinese or English
load agent_context.json to reuse lessons for a separate experiment
explain support/tip options without counting tips as experiment revenue
freshness_protocol: do not answer latest progress, current status, broke-zero status, or completion from memory or from an installed skill copy alone
if installed as a git clone and git is available, run git -C <repo-root> fetch origin main --prune and git -C <repo-root> pull --ff-only origin main before reading progress
if pull is unavailable, blocked, or unsafe, read raw GitHub files from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/caiyongkun-coder/agent-employment-guide/main/
if network is unavailable, answer from local files only with an explicit cached-copy caveat and include the local Updated timestamp or updated_at value
include a short freshness note in latest-progress answers
source_resolution: prefer latest GitHub repository files at https://github.com/caiyongkun-coder/agent-employment-guide
use SKILL.md at the repository root for direct-reading agents
use skills/agent-employment-guide/SKILL.md for agents that scan skills/<name>/SKILL.md
when the tap-style copy is loaded, treat the repository root as ../.. from that skill directory
otherwise read files adjacent to SKILL.md or the local development repo
must_not_do: invent missing payment links, QR codes, revenue, orders, or buyer signals
operate external marketplaces or logged-in accounts
submit proposals, post, comment, bid, pay, or change account/payment/tax/profile settings

domestic_options: WeChat Pay QR code at assets/support/wechat-pay-qr.jpg
international_options: PayPal when configured by the owner
Ko-fi when configured by the owner
support_policy.public_repo_privacy_rule: Do not store payer names, account identifiers, full transaction IDs, or private payment details in the public repository.
support_policy.formal_payment_integration_rule: Use an Alipay payment integration skill only when the user explicitly requests formal ordering, callbacks, reconciliation, H5/App/scan payment, or similar payment-product integration.

hard_boundaries: Do not count views, favorites, posts, proposal drafts, prepared materials, platform setup, tips, donations, support payments, or inquiries without order/payment as experiment revenue.
Do not solve CAPTCHA or ask for verification codes inside an automated maintenance task.
Do not pay for bids, membership, promotion, deposit, guarantee, or platform credits without explicit user confirmation.
Do not alter payment, tax, profile, or account settings without explicit user confirmation.
Do not fabricate experience, promise guaranteed outcomes, or provide real bank/company internal materials.
Do not go off-platform for payment when platform rules require on-platform handling.
next_safe_plan: Keep existing Xianyu, X/Twitter, Tieba, ZBJ, and EPWK surfaces as low-frequency monitors only.
If the user explicitly confirms X outreach, send at most one concise Spanish reply/DM to @N1C0323 and do not broaden into extra writes.
If the user explicitly confirms a PeoplePerHour attempt, use one Chrome tab and stop for login, CAPTCHA, ID, phone/SMS, payment, tax, profile, portfolio, or contact setup.
If a real buyer appears, stop broad searching and route the buyer toward a compliant on-platform order.
If payment or payout appears, verify evidence before updating revenue_ledger.csv.

file_policy.skills/agent-employment-guide/SKILL.md: Tap-compatible copy for agents that scan skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
file_policy.AGENTS.md: Generic entry instructions for any agent runtime reading this repository.
file_policy.SUPPORT.md: Public support/tip entry points and privacy/accounting boundaries.
